actions.title: Close the recall gap for W3

method.mode: Face-to-face interviews on tablets, collected with KoboToolbox.
method.sampling: Placeholder: multi-stage random sample across urban, semi-urban and rural polling areas.
method.weighting: Placeholder: weighted to age, gender and area of the electoral roll.
method.qualitative: Six unstructured interviews with local reporters and opinion makers. Views are summarised as bullets and are not statistically representative.
limits: Vote intent is a snapshot, not a forecast.
Name recall depends on how names were read out to respondents.
Small sub-groups carry wider margins of error.
